title: PenPal to SongPal
style: rock, 1990s indie rock duet, jangle pop, alternative rock, conversational male and female vocals, warm acoustic guitar, clean electric guitar riffs, rolling synth bassline, nostalgic, melodic college rock vibe, steady mid-tempo drums, female vocals, warm, harmony, pop, alternative rock, deep, soft, acoustic, vocal, electric, male vocals, nostalgic, clean, indie rock, bassline, ambient, jangle pop, steady, light
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Warm jangling acoustic guitars with a soft shaker rhythm]

[Verse 1: Female Vocals]
[The PenPal]
I sent an envelope across the wide sea line
Written in blue ink a message caught in time
Just a paper ghost looking for a friend
Asking how you're living on the other end
We were penpals tracing lines in the dark
Leaving carbon tracks waiting for a spark

[Verse 2: Male Vocals]
[The SongPal]
Well I got your letter read it in the light
But I didn't want to write you back tonight
So I set up the mic dialed in the gain
Turned your paper words into a vocal strain
No more envelopes no more ink to dry
I'm sending you a song across the open sky

[Chorus: Duet Harmony]
From a PenPal letter to a SongPal track
We write the frequencies and send them right back
Hosted on the VDS secure and clean
No middleman loops in our sovereign machine
From the written word to the singing voice
We make the connection we make the choice

[Verse 3: Female Vocals]
[The PenPal]
I got your audio played it on the edge
Felt the bass rumble on my window ledge
It’s a new way to write a new way to speak
Sharing vocal stems day by day week by week
No registration cages no passwords to keep
Just a magic link waking up the deep

[Verse 4: Male Vocals]
[The SongPal]
We link the fleets together under one domain
Penpal.wiki joins the songpal.studio lane
We draft the propositions we map out the plan
Releasing the record as fast as we can
Your words are my melody my track is your page
